prompt: A clean, modern desktop app screenshot for a tool that shares state between isolated application tiles. Flat straight-on view of the interface only — no browser chrome, no window title bar, no device frame, no desktop background, no cursor. Layout: a dashboard grid of four to six rectangular tile panels of differing sizes, with thin electric blue connector lines drawn between three of them to suggest data flowing across tiles. Each tile holds a small abstract chart or list. Visual style: near-white cool grey page background, pure white panels, hairline light grey borders, 4px corner radius, generous whitespace, completely flat with no gradients, no glow, no shadows, no 3D, no photographic elements. Single electric blue accent colour used sparingly. CRITICAL: render every piece of text as soft light-grey rounded placeholder bars of varying widths. Absolutely no legible letters, words, numbers, or logos anywhere in the image.
